title: Government's Obligation to Credit Penalty and Amount to Fund

content.scenario: The Government of India has collected a penalty of Rs. 10 lakhs under section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, and an amount of Rs. 5 lakhs under section 96. The Government must now decide where to credit these amounts.
content.outcome: The Government must credit the penalty of Rs. 10 lakhs and the amount of Rs. 5 lakhs to such fund as may be prescribed under the Act.

user_queries: What happens to the penalty collected under section 21?
Where is the amount collected under section 96 credited?
What is the Government's obligation regarding the penalty and amount collected?
